messages:
maya: Heads-up: Acme just reconfirmed pilot requirements. They want SSO, org-admin, and audit-search in pilot. Their contract ties the pilot start to those features. We need to pick a path by EOD.

sam: Quick options:
A) Keep current date, scope-reduce (we cut non-essential features)
B) Add +2 weeks to include audit-search UI
C) Ship SSO + basic admin, capture audit events server-side, ship audit UI in v1

leo: Technical note: audit-search UI is ~2w FE + 1w infra + 3d QA. Building backend event capture (no UI) is ~4d. SSO + minimal admin is already largely done.

anya: Commercial note: Acme wants a pilot window starting 2026-04-15. They sign if pilot includes both admin & audit UI. They said +1 week slip is borderline but might be tolerated; +2 weeks likely ok, +4 weeks not. I can bargain for server-side logs but they prefer product-complete pilot.

emily: Risk matrix quick take:
- A) Fastest to market, higher support risk if no audit UI (support load + trust)
- B) Lowest post-launch support risk, delays go against sales cadence
- C) Middle ground; acceptable to many customers but not to Acme per their note

jin: Design can produce a stripped-down audit UI (search + table, no filters) in 6-8 app-days if we reuse existing components. We can ship a v0 that meets Acme visually.

sam: I propose the following gating checklist for pilot (MVP gate):
```
Pilot MVP gate (must be green):
- SSO: SAML + OIDC flows, IdP metadata import
- Admin: user list, invite/remove, role toggle
- Audit events: server-side capture + retention policy
- Audit access: either basic UI or secure logs endpoint for Acme
- Canary plan: feature flag + 10% pilot orgs + rollback path
- Ops: runbook, on-call pager for first 72h
```

leo: On the ops point: we'll require a hard feature-flag and a canary traffic plan. Also need an emergency rollback tag. That adds ~1d dev/integration work.

maya: Vote check (react with :thumbsup: for A, :fast_forward: for B, :white_check_mark: for C). Please vote in next 90m.

anya: Pinging Acme for flexibility: will confirm if they can accept server-logs + v1 audit UI with +1 week buffer. Reporting back in this thread.

emily: While we wait, suggested cutlist if we keep date (trying to free 2w): defer to v1:
- SDK telemetry v2 (advanced usage metrics)
- multi-region fallback prework
- tenant-level tagging UI
- non-essential onboarding tours
These are low customer-impact for pilot but high dev effort.

sam: I updated the JIRA epic (RDW-3412) to reflect the three options and added sub-tasks for the canary plan and runbooks. Hard freeze set to 2026-04-06 in the epic.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created canary flag feature/mvp-acme, scheduled rollout at 2143660600

anya: Acme replied: they can accept server-side logs + audit UI in v1 only if we grant a 1-week extension (so +1 week). They prefer full audit UI but will accept the compromise. They asked for a signed note committing to audit UI delivery date.

maya: Decision: take +1 week (option B but smaller). We will: apply cutlist (emily's items) + accept 1-week slip, guarantee audit UI delivered in v1 by 2026-05-01, and prep canary with feature flag.

sam: Noted. Ill update timeline in the roadmap, adjust the milestone: Launch-> pilot start 2026-04-22. JIRA RDW-3412 updated with v1 audit UI due date + dependent tasks.

leo: Eng action items:
- implement server-side audit capture today (P0)
- land feature flag and canary plan by EOD tomorrow
- rebase release branch and tag rollback commit

jin: Design action: ship minimal audit UI spec (search + table) to RD by EOD tomorrow. Add "v1 improvements" note in header.

maya: Ops: schedule shiproom for 2026-04-21 and assign on-call. Customer success to prepare comms for Acme pilot + expected limitations.

anya: I'll send the signed note to Acme confirming audit UI v1 ETA and updated pilot date. Ill paste the email here once sent.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for branch feature/mvp-acme at 2143660600
